added_lines: . fionla armstrong mcguire will share memories and stories gathered from her late mother lena armstrong nee henry on earley’s business, drumshanbo , tuesday nov 3rd at 4 p.m. in drumshanbo library. in this month of november we remember all our loved one who have gone home to god. masses will be offered during each week for the month of november for our loved ones. you may wish to write their names on the november list (available in both churches) we receive the grace of an indulgence by visiting a cemetery for the first week of november. we can also receive the grace of indulgence by a visit to a church from 12 noon on all souls day (nov 1st ) to midnight on all souls day (nov 2nd) cemetery prayer . may god’s perpetual light shine upon the faces of all laid to rest here. may the lives they lived in our homes continue to inspire and to guide us on the way. may the memories we carry and share in stories, keep them part of our lives and part of our family. may the gentle summer rains fall like tears from the skies of heaven to bless them. may the wild flowers and the summer meadows whisper their prayer in the gentle breeze of silence. may the birds of the dawn chorus sing their prayer of the beauty and joy of heaven. may we always reverence this sacred clay as the holy ground that holds seeds of hope. may each time we visit, walk, sit, pray and listen here bring us closer to the heart of god’s kindness. may the angels guide them, the saints protect them and the prayer of mary hold them in the light. amen. saturday 24th october 8.00 p.m : pat gallagher and his parents patrick and bridgit and johnny mcgourty . sunday 25th october 9.00 a.m : pro populo sunday 25th october . teresa kane and thomas, maryanne & joe heron & sarah mcmanus & deceased families. clocks go back this weekend saturday evening mass will be at 7 p.m. from next weekend. drumshanbo

annual ceremony for the deceased of kilronan parish the annual ceremony in which we will remember all those from our parish who have died since last november will take place on friday evening 6th november at 7.30pm in the parish church, keadue. families as well as the wider community are invited to attend and to take part in this evening of remembering. remembrance service catering: short meeting re catering for the parish remem- brance service (6/11/26 7.30pm) on tuesday 27th @7pm in choir room keadue church. november lists available. please fill & return to churches. two masses of- fered weekly for our deceased conditions for november indulgences from 12 o'clock on 1 november until mid night on 2 nov ., all who have a) confessed, b) received communion c) prayed for the pope's intentions (one our father and hail mary, or any other prayer of one's choice) can gain one plenary indulgence - applicable only to the souls of the departed - by visiting a church or oratory and there reciting one our father and the apostle's creed. from 1 - 8 november the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence once per day - applicable only to the holy souls. con- ditions a, above apply also. the energy of true religion'to love god and love your neighbour - this is one of the most attractive of the say- ings of jesus. it is an encouragement to live fully with what brings the greatest joy in life - true love of god and the neighbour. it is at the heart of good religion, and what attracts many to jesus. bad religion puts law above love. bad religion fights for the partial truth of religion. we risk being victims of bad religion, just as we can be victims of bad nationalism, bad psychology or any other badway of living. jesus' life was to propose good religion and to live by it. the religion of some of the pharisees was bad, in that it was incomplete in its scope. fr. donal neary sunday 25th october 2026 mass times saturday 24th october ballyfarnon 7 p.m. sunday 25th october arigna 10.00 a.m. sunday 25th october keadue 11.30 a.m. monday 26th october arigna 11 a.m funeral tuesday 27th october keadue 10.00 a.m wednesday 28th october no mass thursday 29th october ballyfarnon 10.00 a.m friday 30th october arigna 10am

parish offertory collections : thank you for your very generous support on 18th oct last: arigna €435, ballyfarnon €460, keadue €440. st. ronan’s gaa there was no winner of the lotto jackpot when the draw was held at the weekend. the numbers drawn were 2,5,8 & 25 . consolation prizes were won by the following: €70 jackie gallagher, arigna , €30 marie shivnan, ballyfarnon , €20 teresa hennessy, keadue , €20 ray christie, drumshanbo , €20 mary mctiernan, c/o mo chairde, keadue . ballyfarnon jackpot now €3,600. next draw sunday evening enter online at stronansgaa.com. if you have been bereaved by suicide , whether recently or many years ago, and are aged 18 or over, you are invited to join hugg for a soft pastel creative workshop on tuesday, 10 november, from 7:15pm to 9pm at the hodson bay hotel , roscommon road, barrymore, hodson bay, roscommon (n37 xr82). arigna hall development plans . arigna community development company have engaged consultants to carry out a feasibility study for the development of a new community centre for arigna. we want to get your views and opinions on the proposed development. with this in mind, a public meeting is being held in the miners bar, arigna on wednesday next 28th october at 8pm where the consultants will present a first draft of the feasibility report including draft drawings of the proposed new community centre. please come along as this may be your last chance to have a say on how the new community centre will be developed. memories and stories. finola armstrong-mcguire, will share memories & fireside chats gathered from her late mother lena armstrong nee henry on earleys business, drumshanbo & the staff who worked there in 1940s & 50s, venue -
